subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Barrel and Cylindrical Cams: 3-D Motion
description: One-minute skill: Barrel and Cylindrical Cams: 3-D Motion.

hook.text: Flat cams push followers up and down. Barrel cams move them side to side.

buildup.text: A groove cut in a rotating cylinder guides a pin follower along the axis.

discovery.text: The groove shape controls timing, speed, and direction of the linear output.

twist.text: A barrel cam can push and pull — no return spring needed.

climax.text: Textile machines use barrel cams to move yarn guides in complex patterns.

punchline.text: Wrap the cam around a drum and motion goes 3-D.

quiz.question: What advantage does a barrel cam have over a disc cam?
options: It can operate at higher speeds without vibration
Its groove can push and pull the follower, needing no return spring
It creates smoother acceleration profiles automatically
